risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed but reflects material stress from low commodity prices, substantial net losses, declining production, and a 2016 net operating cash flow deficit. Liquidity was strengthened through equity issuance and debt refinancing, although 2017 funding depends on cash on hand and management retains contingent options including additional borrowing, securities issuance, and asset sales. Use of adjusted earnings and numerous exclusions may complicate assessment of underlying performance.
